## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector thrust (Energy and Communication leading while Financials and Consumer Discretionary lag) and leadership concentration is narrow (top performers concentrated in Tech/Energy/Communication), supporting a neutral stance with no clear market directional bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND. Communication lead: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +2.15% | 1M: -5.48%) RECOVERY. Technology showing pockets of strength but mixed: INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +9.66% | 1M: -21.29%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Financials lag: JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND, broader Financials weak (Financials: 6/20 positive estimated). Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -6.89% | 1M: -5.07%) BELOW TREND and TSLA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND; Utilities also weak with rotation signs.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5 (by 1W): NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +15.45% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +25.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +12.77% | 1M: +25.42%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Communication, Technology and Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -11.87% | 1M: -16.20%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -6.00%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +9.08%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -2.79%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and Consumer Discretionary names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +19.30%), INTU (1W: +15.45%), PLTR (1W: +14.16%), VLO (1W: +13.00%), MPC (1W: +12.77%). Note major divergence: several large-cap names (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, META, V, MA) show 1W ≠ 1M (RECOVERY vs BELOW TREND patterns) — this is a MAJOR divergence, so tactical moves should await confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed / rotational: AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -1.38%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.15% | 1M: -4.07%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth estimate: Tech: 12/24 positive — breadth shallow, watch for follow-through rather than trend-confirming breakout.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Weak-to-mixed: JPM (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +2.39% | 1M: -3.81%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +2.66% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth estimate: Financials: 6/20 positive — overall softness, so Financials are not confirming broad risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Stable-to-constructive: JNJ (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth estimate: Healthcare: 9/17 positive — defensive names holding up, but selectivity needed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Maintain neutral positioning and favor exposure to Energy and selected Communication names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND performance (XOM, CVX, NFLX); reduce exposure to weak Consumer Discretionary and broad Financials that remain BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — avoid directional concentration until 1M confirmations broaden.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +19.21%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through; UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND — monitor guidance/data flow. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -6.89% | 1M: -5.07%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND — downside risk on consumer discretionary.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth est. 7/10 positive) — strong 1W performance and 1M confirmation. BEARISH: Financials (Breadth est. 6/20 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (Breadth est. 4/14 positive) — watch credit/data flow and consumer trends.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA: failure to reclaim this week’s intraday range would reinforce BELOW TREND continuation; AAPL: hold of 1M lows required to avoid deeper correction (ABOVE/BREACH trigger). UNH: sustainment above this week’s close would support ABOVE TREND continuation; NFLX: decisive follow-through above this week’s breakout validates momentum.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
AAPL (+50): Headline: aggressive AI product push; Price: AAPL (1W: -4.27% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price diverging (distribution risk). CSCO (+60): headline re: $2.1B AI orders — watch order flow; price not in detailed view here but sentiment confirms sector rotational interest. ABBV (+60): positive trial readouts noted; ABBV price not in key table but fundamental catalyst warrants monitoring.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
PLTR (-50): Headline: price target cut; Price: PLTR (1W: +14.16% | 1M: +3.67%) ABOVE TREND — clear divergence (bullish price action vs bearish headlines) — watch for reversal. RCL (-55): Headline: disappointing guidance; Price: RCL (1W: -8.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming price weakness. UNH (-45): Headline: surge in health costs; Price: UNH (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment flag despite price strength; monitor margins and guidance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NFLX ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND and UNH ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Major divergence across large-cap Tech (AAPL, NVDA, MSFT) and mixed news sentiment (PLTR positive price vs bearish headlines) is the key risk to monitor.
